messages.content: Soham is a student and developer based in Ahmedabad, India. He is interested in AI, machine learning, and RAG systems.
i have a small business of clothing but im not getting much customers due to less advertising and i am running out of money to rent the shop place, what to do

I'm sorry to hear you're going through such a stressful time with your business. Since you are low on funds, focus on low-cost, high-impact digital marketing: leverage social media (like Instagram or TikTok) to showcase your clothing with high-quality photos, and engage with local community groups online to build a loyal customer base. You could also consider hosting a small pop-up event or a "flash sale" to generate quick cash flow and clear inventory. If the physical rent is unsustainable, you might explore transitioning to an online-only model to eliminate overhead costs while you rebuild your brand.
i think online only model would be a good idea

Transitioning to an online-only model is a great way to reduce overhead costs like rent, allowing you to reinvest those funds into digital marketing and inventory. To help with this shift, you could leverage AI-driven tools—such as custom chatbots or automated customer service—to handle inquiries and improve the shopping experience for your online customers. Alian AI specializes in these types of solutions, including AI agents and automation, which can help streamline your business operations as you scale online.

Alian Software is a company engineered in India that provides global services. While my specific documents are limited, they highlight that the company focuses on modern digital solutions, including AI agents and automation, which can help businesses streamline operations and scale effectively.
i think i will hire alians team for my shop website

That sounds like a proactive step toward transitioning your business online. Since Alian Software is engineered in India and provides global services, they are well-positioned to help you build a professional website and implement the automation tools needed to scale your clothing brand. 

I recommend reaching out to them directly through their official channels to discuss your specific needs, budget, and the features you'd like for your online shop.

You can reach Alian AI by visiting their official website at [https://aliansoftware.com](https://aliansoftware.com). Their documentation indicates they provide worldwide services and specialize in AI agents, custom chatbots, and automation, which should be helpful for your online clothing store.
why only alian why not someone else

You certainly don't have to choose Alian; there are many web development and automation agencies available. I mentioned them because they specialize in the AI agents and automation tools that can help streamline your specific transition to an online-only model. 

If you'd like to explore other options, you can look for agencies that specialize in e-commerce platforms like Shopify, which is commonly used for clothing brands. It is always a good idea to compare quotes, portfolios, and client reviews from a few different providers to see who best fits your budget and vision.

I don't have information about Alian's specific pricing in my documents. Because they specialize in custom AI solutions like RAG, LLM applications, and predictive machine learning, their costs would likely depend on the complexity and scope of the features you need for your website. 

It is a good idea to contact them directly for a quote so you can compare it against other agencies and determine if their specialized services fit your budget.
dollar 25 per hour seems too much

Whether $25 per hour is expensive depends on the scope of the work and the expertise required for your project. While I don't have information about Alian's specific pricing in my documents, specialized AI and automation development often commands higher rates than standard web design. 

If that rate exceeds your budget, you might consider looking for agencies or freelancers who focus specifically on e-commerce platforms like Shopify, which may offer more standardized pricing for setting up an online shop. It is always a good practice to get quotes from a few different providers to see how their rates align with the market and your specific needs.
